title: ligularia yesoensis var. crenifera
intro: Ligularia yesoensis var. crenifera, commonly known as Japanese gold leaf or Yellow Ligularia, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Ligularia yesoensis var. crenifera are believed to be attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, as well as its potential to act as an antioxidant and free-radical scavenger. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
